column10: OCHA casualty series begins 2005; settler-violence count series begins 2006; displacement series begins 2009.
Includes the Oct-Dec 2023 escalation; settlement planning and new outposts also expanded (see review).

Core displacement chart is provisional and excludes at least 20,805 displaced from Tulkarm and Nur Shams camps attributed by OCHA to Israeli forces; recorded separately to avoid mixing series. OCHA also reports 12,557 displaced from Jenin camp in operations by Israeli or Palestinian forces; excluded from Israel-only count due mixed attribution.
